origin.description: Replacement form of stri_datetime_add. Adds units and returns the modified time.
origin.usage: stri_datetime_add(time, units = "seconds", tz = NULL, locale = NULL) <- value

arguments.name: time
arguments.text: A POSIXct, or a character, Date, POSIXlt, or factor value coerced with as.POSIXct.

arguments.name: units
arguments.text: One of years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds, or milliseconds. A unique prefix is enough.

arguments.name: tz
arguments.text: NULL or "" for the default time zone, or one ICU time zone identifier.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: NULL or "" for the default locale. @calendar=name selects a calendar.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: Integer vector. Signed number of units to add. There is no default.

origin.details: The same calendar addition as stri_datetime_add. The second positional argument is units, not value.
origin.example:
x <- `stri_datetime_add<-`(stri_datetime_create(2015, 1, 31, tz = "UTC"), units = "months", tz = "UTC", value = 1)
cat(paste0("stri_datetime_add<- of 2015-01-31 plus one month returns ", sprintf("%.0f", unclass(x)), ".\n"))

arguments.name: time
arguments.text: Seconds since the epoch, a date-time string in one of the six as.POSIXct formats, NA, or a list of one kind.

arguments.name: units
arguments.text: A unique prefix of years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds, or milliseconds.

arguments.name: tz
arguments.text: None or "" for the default ICU zone, or one zone identifier.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: None or "" for the default locale. @calendar=name selects a calendar.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: An int or a list of ints. Required. Omitting it raises ValueError.

translation.details: Calls the same addition as stri_datetime_add. The callable name is stri_datetime_add_assign. The second positional argument is units.
translation.value: A float, or NA. A list or tuple returns a list.
translation.example:
from stringi.datetime import stri_datetime_add_assign, stri_datetime_create
x = stri_datetime_add_assign(stri_datetime_create(2015, 1, 31, tz="UTC"), units="months", tz="UTC", value=1)
print(f"stri_datetime_add<- of 2015-01-31 plus one month returns {x:.0f}.")
